نتعاط (form VI)
# نَتَعَاطَ (nataʕāṭa) /na.ta.ʕaː.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# نُتَعَاطَ (nutaʕāṭa) /nu.ta.ʕaː.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
